title: fix(console): under draft preview a list column on a draft-only field no longer makes the whole list fail
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzg2evNa1V3zxrQq3KX

Fixes #34807
Clause-②: yes (widening — one new @object-ui/i18n `list.*` key only; no exported prop, no typed interface member; the `_draftOnly` field marker is an internal undeclared key on an untyped value)
Metadata-protocol: none
Premise corrected: 6946635368
Ruling-ref: 6946403206
Surface-amendment: 6946712960

This PR ships the **list half** of the card. The form half landed as #34843 (13e0305c33); this branch was cut from it and has merged `origin/main` since, so the diff below is the list half alone.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：草稿预览（`?preview=draft`）里，列表视图如果有一列是只存在于草稿中的字段，现在列表照常显示：这一列用草稿里的标签画出来、内容为空；查询、筛选、排序、搜索字段都不再带上这个字段。若用户的筛选或排序用到了它，列表上方会有一行说明「这个字段只在草稿中，发布前不参与筛选/排序」。
- **为什么改**：数据接口按已发布的对象校验字段名，草稿新增的字段一旦出现在查询里，整个列表就返回 400，预览里看到的是报错而不是 AI 刚加好的列，用户会以为 AI 做坏了。
- **风险与回滚**：只在预览模式下生效；预览之外列表拿到的仍是原来的 adapter 本身，`ListView` 读到的标记集合为空，所有请求逐字节不变（对照测试钉住）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`（`omitDraftOnlyFilterFields` 剔除筛选条件、`servedCols` 投影与 `searchFieldsSent` 三处，影响已发布包）；`ui/packages/app-shell/src/preview/unpublishedObjectReads.ts`（`usePreviewListDataSource` 与 `getObjectSchema` 的预览读取）；`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewListRenderer.tsx`（包装缓存按 objectDef 失效）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.harness.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/preview/__tests__/unpublishedObjectReads.draftOnly-34807.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.draftOnlyColumn-34807.test.tsx`，预期 3 个文件、116 个测试全部通过。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `@object-ui/app-shell`, `preview/unpublishedObjectReads.ts`:
  - `withUnpublishedObjectReads(ds, onUnpublished, readOverlay?)`: given the overlay read, its `getObjectSchema` answers the form half's `readDraftPreviewObjectSchema`. That is the **published** object document plus each field only the draft declares, under its draft label, marked `_draftOnly: true`, with the published sortability projection kept. Without the overlay read it behaves as before.
  - New hook `usePreviewListDataSource(ds, revision)` (module-level, not exported from the package): the adapter **itself** outside preview; inside preview, one wrapper per data source and revision. It caches on its inputs through a ref, not on a memo identity (ui/AGENTS.md #10).
- `objectViewListRenderer.tsx` passes the metadata provider's `getItem` (read through a ref) as the overlay read. It keeps one wrapper per data source per draft-aware `objectDef`, so a newly drafted field makes the list re-read its definition. `ObjectDataPage` and `InterfaceListPage` hand `ListView` `usePreviewListDataSource(dataSource, objectDef)`.
- `@object-ui/plugin-list`, `ListView`:
  - It reads the marker once (`draftOnlyFields`, a shared empty set outside preview).
  - It leaves marked names out of the authored `$select` columns, the speculative field harvest, `$expand`, and the server export's fields.
  - It leaves them out of `$filter`: `buildEffectiveFilter` gains an optional `draftOnly` argument that strips every comparison on such a field from the merged node. This applies in the fetch, the child-view node and the export.
  - It leaves them out of `$orderby` (`serverSort`), and out of the `$searchFields` it sends with a search term.
  - It keeps them out of the Filter panel (kept only while a held condition names it, like hidden fields) and the Sort picker (listed disabled only while the current sort names it).
  - The column is drawn empty under the draft label. A sort or filter that names such a field is left out, and one status line says so: new key `list.draftOnlyQueryDropped`.
  - The `$searchFields` strip (`searchFieldsSent`) covers the list's own fetch and every place the view's `searchableFields` is handed on: the grouped grid's node, gantt, the server export and kanban lane paging.
- `@object-ui/i18n`: `list.draftOnlyQueryDropped` in all 11 locales (zh-Hant regenerated by `scripts/gen-zh-hant.mjs`), and in `LIST_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS`.
- Nothing is exported. No server, protocol or REST change; the data contract is unchanged by ruling 6946403206.

## Why

Under `?preview=draft` a list view may show a column on a field the draft adds. The data door validates every `$select`, `$filter`, `$orderby` and `$searchFields` name against the **published** object, so that one column made it refuse the whole list query with `400 INVALID_FIELD` (premise 6946635368). Preview stays read-only for data (ruling 6946403206, ADR-0037 Phase 1). The list therefore draws the draft column empty instead of asking the server for a field the server does not have.

**$searchFields, measured.** The data door checks `searchFields` whether or not a search term rides (the comment beside `host.assertSearchFieldsAreSearchable` in `protocol-data-crud.ts` says so). A temporary probe calling `findData` with `{ $search: 'spec', $searchFields: ['title', 'priority'] }` answered `{ code: INVALID_FIELD, status: 400, field: priority, param: $searchFields }`. The string form gave the same answer. The control `['title']` was served. So the strip goes in the same `ListView` helper (`refersToDraftOnlyField`).

**Why the list strips the sort itself.** `readObjectSortability` drops a field with no projection entry only when the published read **served** a projection. An older deployment, or a never-published object, serves none, so `ListView` strips a draft-only sort explicitly (pinned both ways).

`_draftOnly` is the form half's underscore-private convention between `@object-ui/app-shell` (which sets it) and the plugins (which read it). It is never an authoring key and is never persisted.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.harness.test.tsx`, new top-level describe `ListView.draftOnlyColumn-34807` (8 tests, per the shared-harness rule). Its data source refuses any request naming `priority` with `400 INVALID_FIELD`, as the data door does.
  - The column is drawn under "Priority (draft)", `$select` is exactly `['id','title']`, and there is no error.
  - A viewer filter on it is dropped, the `title` condition is kept, and the note is shown.
  - A sort on it is dropped, both with no projection and with the published projection served.
  - The Filter panel and Sort picker do not offer it.
  - With `searchableFields: ['title','priority']` and a search term, `$search` is kept and `$searchFields` is `['title']`. CONTROL: with the field published, it is `['title','priority']`.
  - CONTROL: with the field published, `$select`, `$orderby` and `$filter` carry it and there is no note.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/preview/__tests__/unpublishedObjectReads.draftOnly-34807.test.tsx`:
  - The wrapper answers `_draftOnly` under the draft label and keeps the projection. CONTROL: no overlay read.
  - The hook is the adapter itself outside preview, and one wrapper per revision inside.
  - `ObjectDataPage` and `InterfaceListPage` hand `ListView` the wrapper in preview and the adapter itself outside it.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.draftOnlyColumn-34807.test.tsx`: the real `ObjectView` and `ListView` under preview draw the list with the draft column, and no request names `priority`. CONTROL: outside preview the request still sends it, and the list shows the error state.

## Acceptance notes

- **Grouped grid: not covered here, carried by #34898** (seat ruling A: `plugin-grid` reads `_draftOnly`). `plugin-grid` is outside this PR's surface. The grid builds its own `$select` and `groupBy` from the object definition, and in preview that definition declares the draft-only field, so it passes the grid's declared-field gates (`passesProjectionGate`, `isProjectableField`). Measured with the real `ListView` and `object-grid` over a data source that refuses any request naming `priority`:
  - Columns `[title, priority]`, grouped by the published `status`: `ListView`'s own fetch sent `$select [id,title,status]` and was clean, and the header query sent `groupBy [status]` and was clean. Each group's row page sent `$select [id,title,priority,status]` and drew `INVALID_FIELD` inside the group.
  - Columns `[title]`, grouped by the draft-only `priority`: the header query sent `{ groupBy: ['priority'] }`, and the grid drew "Error loading grid". The data door's `assertGroupByFieldsExist` answers an unknown `groupBy` name with `400 INVALID_FIELD`, `param: 'groupBy'`.
  - The grouped grid's other inputs are clean from this PR: `ListView` hands it the stripped filter and the stripped `searchableFields`.
- **$searchFields: fixed here** (see Why: measured 400, stripped, pinned, ablated).
- **Design note: what dropping a draft-only comparison does to the filter's meaning (`or` groups).** A comparison on a draft-only field is removed from wherever it sits in the filter tree. A group left with one child becomes that child, and a group left with none disappears. Inside an `and` group, or at the top level, the removal **widens** the result, because one fewer condition must hold. Inside an `or` group it **narrows** that group (`A or D` becomes `A`), so rows only `D` would have matched are not shown. An `or` group whose every child was draft-only disappears, which widens the result again. None of these matches what the draft would answer once it is published. It happens only in preview, and the note line names the field that was left out. An earlier report from this run called this simply the `or`-group widening; the narrowing half is the correction. Treating the dropped comparison as true would widen an `or` group to every row, which seemed worse than showing fewer rows with the note.
- **Never-published object.** For an object that has no published version yet, the list now reads the draft definition, with every field marked draft-only. Before, the published read failed and the list had no definition. The data read still answers through `withUnpublishedObjectReads`'s unpublished path, so the empty state keeps its publish sentence. A view sort on such an object also shows the dropped-sort note.
- Draft edits to a field the published object already declares (a relabel, a new option) are not shown in the list; those fields keep their published definition, as in the form half.
- i18n budget: `i18n-locale-en` reads 61,878 of 62,000 gzip bytes on the merged tree (122 B headroom), so the key stays in the eager en pack. The ceiling was not touched.
